The Ultimate Duelist Series (UDS) gave Duelists in North America and Latin America the opportunity to win championship belts that became the envy of Duelists worldwide. Now, each of the victorious Duelists have gathered with their championship belts at the Konami E-Sports Arena for a chance to win an even greater prize – a one-of-a-kind UDS Championship ring! This ring is made with 14K yellow gold-plating, sterling silver, hieroglyph engravings, 98 real white diamonds, 50 rubies, and 32 yellow sapphires.

This ring made with 14K yellow gold-plating, sterling silver, hieroglyph engravings, 98 real white diamonds, 50 rubies, and 32 yellow sapphires awaits the winner of the Undisputed UDS Championship Tournament!

You can catch the action of the tournament on Twitch and YouTube, with additional coverage of the event right here on Konami’s event coverage blog! Follow the tournament to see which Duelist becomes the undisputed UDS Champion and takes home the championship ring!
